Name: Big Silo by MattCo
Author: mdurham6890
Description:
[size=4][b]Big Silo[/b][/size]
Upgrade your standard Silo into a [b]Big Silo[/b] at Robin's shop. Stores enough hay to feed [b]32 animals for a full 28-day season[/b] — no more running out mid-winter.
[line]
[size=3][b]Details[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hay Capacity:[/b] 896 (up from 240 in the standard Silo)
[*][b]Building Size:[/b] 3x3 tiles (same footprint as the standard Silo)
[*][b]Build Time:[/b] 3 days
[*][b]Upgrade Type:[/b] Upgrades an existing Silo in-place (talk to Robin → Upgrades)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Upgrade Cost[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]400g
[*]400 Stone
[*]5 Gold Bars
[*]40 Clay
[/list]
[size=3][b]How It Works[/b][/size]
Visit Robin's carpenter shop and select [b]Upgrades[/b]. If you have an existing Silo on your farm, the Big Silo upgrade will be available. Select it, choose which Silo to upgrade, and Robin will upgrade it over 3 days. The upgraded silo retains any hay already stored.
The Big Silo features a distinct gold-brick design with a conical roof and metal banding, making it easy to tell apart from the standard Silo at a glance.
[line]
[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0.0+
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder
[*]Run the game through SMAPI
[/list]
[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Content Patcher mod — no Harmony patches, high compatibility with other mods
[*]Safe to add mid-save
[/list]
